name: Vingilot
summary: Eärendil’s star-vessel reborn as a privacy-first, native GTK4 & Libadwaita web browser for Wayland desktops.
description: Vingilot is a fast, distraction-free GNOME web browser engineered with GTK4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Named after the sacred ship of Eärendil that bore the Silmaril across the firmament, it features hardware-accelerated Wayland rendering, strict Flatpak sandbox isolation, and built-in ad/tracker warding.

name: Vingilot Estel
summary: Next-generation experimental GTK4 & Libadwaita web browser powered by Mozilla Servo & WebKit.
description: Vingilot Estel explores next-generation parallel web rendering by combining a native GTK4 & Libadwaita shell with Mozilla Servo and WebKit hybrid engine backends.

name: Mithrandir
summary: Modern GNU/Linux cleaner, optimizer, ClamAV anti-malware, and AI-assisted diagnostics utility in GTK4 / Libadwaita.
description: Mithrandir counsels your Linux system maintenance with deep cleaning, cache pruning, Stacer-grade hardware & battery telemetry, ClamAV quarantine vault, and local/cloud AI diagnostics in a sleek Adwaita interface.

name: Mithrandir-RS (Rust)
summary: Modern GNU/Linux Cleaner, Optimizer, Telemetry & AI Diagnostics rewritten in Rust with GTK4 / Libadwaita.
description: Blazing-fast Rust edition of Mithrandir featuring zero-sleep CPU delta telemetry, dual GPU & battery health sensors, multi-threaded cache cleaning, debounced Smart Boost, ClamAV quarantine vault, and in-app Qwen 2.5 + llama.cpp local AI manager.

name: Imladris
summary: Native GTK4 & Libadwaita Markdown Editor & Polyglot Studio with GtkSourceView 5, WebKitGTK 6.0, AI assistance & MCP Server.
description: Imladris (Rivendell) is a haven for writers and developers. A native Markdown and polyglot studio with live preview, syntax highlighting via GtkSourceView 5, libcmark rendering, integrated VTE terminal, and built-in AI & MCP server capabilities.

name: Debian Cachy Kernel Updater
summary: Automated graphical & CLI forge to fetch, tune, compile, and install CachyOS BORE kernels on Debian.
description: Brings the responsiveness of CachyOS BORE-scheduler and LTO-optimized Linux kernels to Debian systems. Automates fetching upstream kernel sources, applying CachyOS performance patches, building packages, and managing installed kernel versions safely.

name: YouTube Comment Extractor
summary: Extract and analyze YouTube video comments with a modern GTK4 and Libadwaita interface.
description: Graphical tool using yt-dlp to extract, filter, export, and analyze comments from YouTube videos, with support for random winner selection and sentiment export.

name: YouTube Comment Extractor Service
summary: Background web server and system tray service for YouTube Comment Extractor.
description: Background service providing a local web dashboard and system tray indicator to automate and monitor YouTube comment extraction tasks.

name: Súlimo (Arda's Breath)
summary: High-performance C11 hardware capability probe (arda-probe) and runtime optimization policy selector.
description: Súlimo (Arda's Breath) inspects CPU microarchitecture features, cache/memory topology, and Vulkan/OpenCL/SYCL compute backends to select optimal runtime execution profiles.

name: Validity VFS5011 Linux Fix
summary: Automated Linux driver fix and installer for Validity VFS5011 fingerprint sensors (138a:0011, 138a:0017, 138a:0018).
description: Patches, compiles, and installs experimental Linux driver support for Validity VFS5011 fingerprint readers on modern Debian and Ubuntu distributions.
